notes: New: blue ink is now darkened to a clearly visible deep blue, on by default — faint cyan strokes, answer boxes and underlines print dark and whole instead of faint and broken; red, green, black and dark-blue ink are never touched (toggle in Enhance → Advanced)
Fixed: Recent-conversions rows no longer squish into one-word-per-line on phones — the name and details sit on their own line, with full-width Download / Re-printify buttons below

Fixed: more black-page safety — the default color mode is now 'auto' (dark slides inverted, light pages untouched), dark pages are pre-inverted before B&W/grayscale so they can never flood a sheet black, and old saved 'invert' preferences migrate to 'auto'
Improved: the color-mode tiles now show a miniature before/after of what each mode does, and the tour Skip button is a bigger 48px pill
